_notes.datum: XY follows the sloped console; Y=0 is the inner lower crease; Z=0 is the flat pad. Phone camera end is +Y. Thickness is perpendicular to the pad.
_notes.phone: User confirmed 71.1 x 150 mm. Body thickness 8.8 mm retained, body+housing 11.7, body+lenses 13.8. Bottom back seats at Z=0; the first 36 mm of the phone footprint is clear of print.
_notes.console: Both measured nub bases are 17 mm; 93 mm center spacing and historical base Y positions retained. Derived gap between bases is 76 mm.
_notes.nub_openings: 18 mm base / 8.5 mm at absolute Z=4.4 for the selected 0.5 mm per-side clearance. Width does not use local-height fraction.
_notes.camera: Centered 64.5 x 41.5 housing, Y=105 to146.5 in the phone datum. Aperture 65.1 x42.1 with 0.3 per-side clearance. No extra blending relief or opening-enlarging rim chamfer. Housing R6 remains provisional.
_notes.height: Shared outer top plane: Z=1 at Y=0 to Z=4.4 at upper assembly edge. Phone-bearing plane passes through the bottom crease and outer plane at Y=150. Outboard lower structural edges stay 1 mm. Hard installed Z limit 4.5 mm.
_notes.wall: 10.3 / 14.7 mm base-edge side gaps; 0.5 mm wall allowance plus the requested 2 mm inset retained. N4 traced corner replaces R15.
_notes.charging: Retain bottom crease position and central opening. Coil location is not measured; no charging performance claim. Compare the new fit with the bare-phone baseline.
_notes.prototype: V7 full geometry and isolated fit samples. Numerical dimensions checked; physical console fit untested.
_notes.scan: Old scan calibrated to 72.1 mm width is supporting evidence only; new user measurements take precedence.

v7_evidence.gap_reference: Wide nub base edge to inside wall, sideways; confirmed by user.
v7_evidence.height_reference: User confirmed 7.5 mm at about 4.4 mm above the flat pad, not the crown.

nub_center_pitch.status: Retained established position; new photos supply no replacement measured pitch.

v7_evidence.nub_end_positions: Retain established base footprints. Unregistered axial photos do not justify exact new end reductions.
v7_evidence.nub_intermediate_shape: Elliptical transverse envelope through the two measured width/height anchors. Wider than a straight interpolation; intermediate widths are unmeasured.
v7_evidence.nub_end_shape: Rounded elliptic caps with 2.5 mm axial run; full base length plus 0.7 mm end allowance through all heights. Deliberate axial relief replaces 2/2 and 6/5 mm reductions.

corner_plan.scale: Approximate molded-gauge ruler scale, not calibrated 3D metrology.
corner_plan.registration: Lowest captured corner point aligned to lower crease Y=0; straight portion follows the new side-gap reference line. Exact physical alignment remains provisional.
corner_plan.processing: Baseline removal and pin-noise filtering, followed by a smooth convex polynomial fit. Run and endpoint offset retained; no rescaling to R15.
corner_plan.residual_note: Fit residual is relative to the photographed pin silhouette, not a physical accuracy bound.

other_pairs.N1: Confirms separate nub flank features; direct dimensions control width.
other_pairs.N2: Independent long/right axial evidence, full pad baseline absent: no exact end recession inferred.
other_pairs.N3: Independent short/left axial evidence, no marked Y/Z datum: no profile borrowed for right nub.
other_pairs.N5: Second corner section contains a border step and uncertain section plane; retained as evidence, not converted into a false 3D surface.
other_pairs.N6: 10.3 mm lower side gap; direct dimension applied.
other_pairs.N7: 14.7 mm upper side gap; direct dimension applied.

v7_evidence.underside: Retain bounded 3 mm wall / 1.5 mm front relief with rounded progression. Combined with new plan contour; not an exact measured underside.
v7_evidence.test_sequence: Nub clearance collars and independent corner sample before a complete fit test. No printer dispatch.
